_how_to_update: Every Monday, when the GCC Index Weekly Intelligence Brief arrives: set week, week_of (the 'Week of' date, YYYY-MM-DD) and replace the items with that week's lines. 'title' is a short version for the TV (keep under ~90 characters), 'detail' is the fuller line. VERIFY FIRST: GCC Index summaries are AI-generated, so check every company, number and city against at least one news report (ET, BusinessLine, Business Standard, Mint, AIM...) and drop anything you cannot confirm; note the outlets in 'verified'. Monthly: update once a month from gccindex.in/monthly-insights. The TV hides weekly items 10 days after week_of and monthly items 40 days after month_start. The TV labels these 'GCC Research' with a small 'GCC Index' source line (their terms allow use with credit).

items.label: Lead signal
items.title: 11 GCC events this week: 5 new centres, 6 expansions, Bengaluru took 6
items.detail: Eleven GCC events this week — five new centres and six expansions — with Bengaluru taking six of them.
items.verified: Count is GCC Index's own figure. Underlying events confirmed: Hitachi, Shield AI, Apple, Intuit, Couchbase, Kelly (Bengaluru); Zurich, SEI, Protolabs (Hyderabad); Infinite Electronics (Pune).

items.label: Market mover
items.title: Bengaluru: new GCCs from Hitachi and Shield; Apple, Intuit, Couchbase and Kelly expand
items.detail: Bengaluru took six of the eleven events: new centres from Hitachi and Shield, and expansions by Apple, Intuit, Couchbase and Kelly Services.
items.verified: BusinessLine, CRN Asia (Kelly); DQ, Rediff (Hitachi); AIM, shield.ai (Shield AI); Intuit, TechGig (Intuit); DQ, CRN Asia (Couchbase); Economic Times (Apple).

items.label: Company move
items.title: Zurich opens its Hyderabad capability centre, aiming for ~1,000 people by mid-2028
items.detail: Zurich Insurance Group inaugurated its Hyderabad capability centre bringing together technology, AI, data and engineering teams, and plans to grow it to around 1,000 colleagues by mid-2028.
items.verified: BusinessLine, ETHRWorld, Analytics India Magazine, BW People (19 Nov 2026).

items.label: Signal
items.title: Big footprints: SEI's Hyderabad centre has room for 1,200; Apple opens a 14-floor Bengaluru office
items.detail: SEI's expanded HITEC City centre has capacity for about 1,200 professionals, and Apple opened a new 14-floor office in Bengaluru.
items.verified: Business Standard, Times of India, Deccan Chronicle (SEI); Economic Times, Deccan Herald (Apple). Removed Maersk Pune ~2,000 seats and Apple 1,000+ capacity: not found in news reports.

items.label: Month in focus
items.title: October: 16 GCC moves (6 new centres, 10 expansions) and 1,160 jobs announced
items.detail: Pune and Hyderabad level at five events each; financial services the largest sector. Momentum down 24% on September.
items.verified: Monthly totals are GCC Index's own figures (shown credited).

items.label: Top deal
items.title: Kuehne+Nagel opens a 250-role tech centre in Chennai for its digital logistics products
items.detail: Kuehne+Nagel inaugurated a Chennai Tech Centre with 250 roles to build and scale its digital logistics products, with Accenture supporting the launch and hiring.
items.verified: Kuehne+Nagel press release, Logistics Insider, Indian Transport & Logistics (1 Oct 2026).
